name: Magical☆Prince
source:
The story takes place in a different world. Magic exists there and magic power is commonly used. Also, there is another world called the Magic World and the Magic King rules it. The main character is Yuki. Though he can't use magic, he is put in a magic school. As expected, it is hard for him to keep up with other students. One day, when he has a rest in the park, a girl, Mira, suddenly tells him, "Please take over the throne." He says yes without taking it seriously. On the next day, when he wakes up, she stands beside him. It seems the promise they made is true!! She says, "If you break a promise, you'll be erased...." He reluctantly accepts it, but he will need to find a queen....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080424154020/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/8910]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个魔法真实存在、魔力被广泛运用的异世界。此外，还有一个由魔王统治的魔界。主人公佑树虽然不会使用魔法，却被送进魔法学校，果然很难跟上其他学生。一天，他在公园休息时，一名叫米拉的少女突然对他说：‘请继承王位。’佑树没当回事，随口答应。第二天醒来时，米拉竟站在他身边。看来两人的约定是真的！她说：‘违背约定的话，你会被抹消……’佑树只得勉强接受，但接下来还必须找到一位王后……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080424154020/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/8910]Himeya Shop[/url]]
